shared_elements: areas of hatched/grid infill (feather rows in A, lattice panels in B)
justification: The only real correspondence is generic: both surfaces use incised outline drawing with panels of hatched/grid infill and long curving lines, and both compositions run out to the broken edges. A depicts a specific figural subject, a profile winged anthropomorph with headdress, disc-marked body and layered feathering, whereas B shows no figure at all but an architectonic or object-like rectangular form with lattice panels enclosed by concentric arc bands, so the subject matter is essentially unrelated.
